newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers up $1, rest of Europe stable.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers up $1, rest of Europe stable.

text.p: Rotterdam bunkers edged up on Wednesday while prices in the rest of Europe were mostly steady, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil bunkers were quoted in the range $89/$90 fob as the barge market trading range moved up $1 a tonne to $87/$88 ex wharf.
Suppliers said total ARA trading was slightly better than over the last two days, but still little more than 10,000 tonnes.
Mediterranean bunkers were broadly steady, except in the Straits of Gibraltar where prices rose by about $2. However, suppliers said there were no apparent supply problems or any leap in demand.
Greek supply remained very short with problems at the state-owned refinery. Prices at Piraeus were steady.
